race.comment: BIG KAPOW (1) resumes. He just missed on debut at Pakenham before two solid runs in handy maidens. He draws well here and has jumped out well in what looks a very winnable race. CANTICLE (8) is a gelding by Brazen Beau on debut for the Ciaron Maher yard. He's shown ability at the jumpouts and Ethan Brown booked is a good lead. Watch betting. FERVENTLY (9) is a Rebel Dane gelding for the Bedggood yard who has jumped out well at Cranbourne. There's been good support for him and the stable is flying, keep safe. KINCUMBER (6) resumes having been in the market on debut at Seymour. Off a long spell, watch the betting off a jumpout win.
